about: Which builtins of the subject the url of a GENERAL PIP takes. Round 36 refused ${subject.serviceAccount} there, and every golden that took a url placeholder named subject.id. Each case puts one more builtin at the end of the url; the upload is refused (400) if a url takes subject.id only. If it is accepted, the route the builtin's value names answers v, so a = n is true; a value that makes no route the call reaches fails the PIP, and a = n is false.

cases.about: Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.

The url ends in r37open-url-name-${subject.name}; for parity-reader the builtin gives its username, parity-reader. The upload is refused (400) if a url takes ${subject.id} only, accepted if it takes subject.name too. Accepted, the route r37open-url-name-parity-reader answers v, so a = n is true.

The url ends in r37open-url-roles-${subject.roles}; for parity-reader the builtin gives the text of its roles, [ROLE_PARITY_READER]. The upload is refused (400) if a url takes ${subject.id} only, accepted if it takes subject.roles too. Accepted, the route r37open-url-roles-[ROLE_PARITY_READER] answers v, so a = n is true.

The url ends in r37open-url-type-${subject.type}; for parity-reader the builtin gives its type, USER. The upload is refused (400) if a url takes ${subject.id} only, accepted if it takes subject.type too. Accepted, the route r37open-url-type-USER answers v, so a = n is true.

The url ends in r37open-url-scopes-${subject.scopes}; for parity-reader the builtin gives its scopes, [openid, profile, email], whose spaces no url takes. The upload is refused (400) if a url takes ${subject.id} only, accepted if it takes subject.scopes too. Accepted, the call fails and both requests are false.

The url ends in r37open-url-permissions-${subject.permissions}; for parity-reader the builtin gives no value without a MAPPING declaration. The upload is refused (400) if a url takes ${subject.id} only, accepted if it takes subject.permissions too. Accepted: the route r37open-url-permissions-null answers v, so a = n is true when the placeholder becomes the text null; the route r37open-url-permissions- answers w, so a = n is false and a = y true when it becomes empty; both are false when it stays as written and its braces fail the call. pipCalls counts the calls to the -null route.

The url ends in r37open-url-entitled-resources-${subject.entitledResources}; for parity-reader the builtin gives no value without of() and as(). The upload is refused (400) if a url takes ${subject.id} only, accepted if it takes subject.entitledResources too. Accepted: the route r37open-url-entitled-resources-null answers v, so a = n is true when the placeholder becomes the text null; the route r37open-url-entitled-resources- answers w, so a = n is false and a = y true when it becomes empty; both are false when it stays as written and its braces fail the call. pipCalls counts the calls to the -null route.

The url ends in r37open-url-permission-scope-${subject.permissionScope}; for parity-reader the builtin gives no value outside iterate, and no PERMISSION_SCOPE PIP is declared. The upload is refused (400) if a url takes ${subject.id} only, accepted if it takes subject.permissionScope too. Accepted: the route r37open-url-permission-scope-null answers v, so a = n is true when the placeholder becomes the text null; the route r37open-url-permission-scope- answers w, so a = n is false and a = y true when it becomes empty; both are false when it stays as written and its braces fail the call. pipCalls counts the calls to the -null route.

The url ends in r37open-url-is-m2m-${subject.isM2M}; for parity-reader the builtin gives no value in a condition. The upload is refused (400) if a url takes ${subject.id} only, accepted if it takes subject.isM2M too. Accepted: the route r37open-url-is-m2m-null answers v, so a = n is true when the placeholder becomes the text null; the route r37open-url-is-m2m- answers w, so a = n is false and a = y true when it becomes empty; both are false when it stays as written and its braces fail the call. pipCalls counts the calls to the -null route. The route r37open-url-is-m2m-false answers u, so both are false with no call to -null when the builtin becomes the boolean false.
